firm_data.firm_description: Adam Leitman Bailey, P.C. is a New York-based real estate law firm. The firm solely practices real estate law, achieving results in the courtroom, board room, and legislative bodies.
notable_facts: One of two law firms with under 30 attorneys to achieve an AV Martindale-Hubbell rating.
Repeated Super Lawyers ranking including a Top 100 honor.
Selection into the Bar Registry of Preeminent Lawyers.
Repeated Best Lawyers and Best Law Firms rankings.
Chambers & Partners award for being one of the leading firms in real estate law.

email.subject: AI for Adam Leitman Bailey, P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Adam,

Your firm's AV Martindale-Hubbell rating is rare achievement, and it reflects the precision your real estate practice demands. That same rigor is what drew us to building Lucio.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
